description.value:
You spend some time getting directly involved in helping your kindom. Choose a skill that your Kingdom is at least trained in, then attempt a basic check. You can never use the same skill for this activity twice in the same Kingdom turn.

@Check[agriculture|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)]
@Check[arts|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)]
@Check[boating|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)]
@Check[defense|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)]
@Check[engineering|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)]
@Check[exploration|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)]
@Check[folklore|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)]
@Check[industry|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)]
@Check[intrigue|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)]
@Check[magic|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)]
@Check[politics|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)]
@Check[scholarship|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)]
@Check[statecraft|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)]
@Check[trade|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)]
@Check[treachery|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)]
@Check[wilderness|dc:resolve(@kingdom.control.dc)]

Critical Success Gain 1 RP. In addition you get a +1 Circumstance Bonus to the next Check you make this turn with the chosen skill.

Success Gain 1 RP.

Failure You fail to generate RP.

Critical Failure You take a -1 Circumstance Penalty to the next Check you make this turn with the chosen skill.
